start: Owner on the Import page; one import was made earlier today and nothing of it was used

user_sees: A row '<day month, time>' with '<n> members · <n> plans with dates · <n> receipts'
must_not: Imports of another branch in this list

user_sees: 'This removes what this file added: <n> members, <n> plans with dates, <n> receipts and <n> plan names from Plans. Nothing you added yourself is removed.'
must_not: Anything removed before the second tap

user_sees: 'Import undone: <n> members, <n> plans with dates, <n> receipts and <n> plan names removed.'
must_not: A member the owner added by hand removed
The receipts still counted in the money totals

start: An import just finished with a problem (another way in: the finished card sends the owner here)

steps.action: Read the red banner on the finished card
user_sees: 'Members are saved, but not all their plans and payments. <reason> Tap “Undo this import” below. Then import the same file again, so every payment comes in only once.'
must_not: A half-saved import with no way named to clean it up

steps.action: Tap 'Undo this import' on the newest row below, then 'Yes, undo it'
must_not: Payments left behind that come in a second time on the next import
A receipt twice for one member

steps.action: Tap 'Undo this import', turn the internet off, tap 'Yes, undo it'
user_sees: Red banner 'The import was not fully undone. Check the internet and tap Undo again. What is already removed stays removed.'
must_not: 'Import undone' when part of it is still there

steps.action: Open the page in a gym that never imported
must_not: An empty card with only a title

start: An import where two members have since checked in and one paid at the desk

user_sees: The counts, then '<n> members, <n> plans with dates stay, with their receipts, because they were used after the import (a check-in, a payment at the desk, extra days or a PT session).'
must_not: A member with a check-in or a desk payment removed

steps.action: Tap 'Undo this import' again, then 'Yes, undo it'
user_sees: 'Import undone: …' followed by the same stay line
must_not: The members who stay losing their plan or receipts

user_sees: The removed members are added again; the ones who stayed are shown as already members
must_not: A member who stayed added a second time

start: Owner of 2 branches; a front-desk sign-in on another device

must_not: Members of the other branch removed by an undo done here

steps.action: Open the Import page as the front desk
must_not: The front desk undoing an import
The server accepting an undo from a front-desk sign-in
